author: Mehrp
body:
So me and Koning(king) have been making a map alongside some other people, and it is nearing completion. This post is made so that we can get feedback, like what to improve on, small tweaks (or big ones if needed) and opinions. I think we also need a map name (me and koning aren't worthsmiths D:). Thanks for reading and enjoy! ^-^
